gatePosts.materialAndStyle: Heavy rusticated light-to-medium grey granite/stone block masonry courses with a smooth central plaque band and a stepped overhanging stone cap cornice

leftSouthPost.name: GatePostLeft_South
leftSouthPost.innerNorthFaceFeatures: Small recessed arched niche in the upper-middle stone courses facing the gate opening

plaquesAndSignsOnEastFace.style: Black rectangular stone/metal plaque with single-line white serif/brush Korean lettering (corrects earlier rough note that misread it as 안동강남유치원)
Standard Korean blue pentagon/shield building number plate (도로명주소 건물번호판)
Two vertically stacked white rectangular notice plates (top: white plate with orange header band; bottom: smaller white smoke-free/school-zone notice plate)
Red-and-white SECOM (에스원) security plate mounted above a bright yellow vertical rectangular warning notice

plaquesAndSignsOnEastFace.text: 안동강남초등학교 / 병 설 유 치 원
plaquesAndSignsOnEastFace.style: Black horizontal rectangular plaque with 2 lines of white lettering and a circular white/silver school emblem (교표) attached on the left border of the plaque

solarAndCctvTrusses.location: Mounted directly atop the flat stone cap of the Left (South) Gatepost (GatePostLeft_South)

structures.name: SouthLowerSolarAndLedTruss
structures.positionOnCap: South/left side of the South Gatepost cap
components: Vertical silver stainless-steel ladder truss post
Tilted rectangular solar photovoltaic panel on top (facing south/upward)
Black vertical rectangular LED electronic display screen (전광판) mounted on the lower front/south face of the truss just above the stone cornice

structures.name: NorthTallerSolarAndCctvTruss
structures.positionOnCap: North/right side of the South Gatepost cap
components: Tall twin-upright silver stainless-steel ladder truss mast
Larger tilted rectangular solar photovoltaic panel at the top
White surveillance CCTV camera unit mounted beneath the solar panel

solarAndCctvTrusses.additionalNorthTruss: A tall vertical silver metal lattice column rises immediately behind the Right (North) Gatepost, supporting the arch canopy frame and overhead wiring

accordionGate.name: AccordionGate
accordionGate.appearance: Retractable stainless-steel/silver scissor-lattice folding gate (접이식 자바라 대문) with rounded arch loops along the top rail, red reflective warning strips near the upper verticals, and caster wheels on the paved threshold

securityBooth_BaeumteoJikimisil.name: 배움터 지킴이실 (School Security / Guard Booth)
securityBooth_BaeumteoJikimisil.location: Inside the campus immediately behind/northwest of the Right (North) Gatepost, sheltered beneath the southern bay of the orange/brown arch canopy (approx. offsetX: 100.5, offsetZ: -1.5)
securityBooth_BaeumteoJikimisil.correctionNote: Located on the RIGHT (North) side inside the main gate, not on the left (south) side

structureAndColors.windows: White-framed sliding observation windows on the south and east faces

signboard.position: Mounted on the south-facing roof fascia directly above the booth window
signboard.upperBanner: Yellow arched top band with green/dark lettering '안동강남초등학교'
signboard.lowerBanner: Dark brown/black horizontal bar with bold yellow/white lettering '배움터 지킴이실'

orangeBrownArchCanopy.name: WoodArchCanopyWalkway / EastGateEntryCanopy
orangeBrownArchCanopy.location: Begins immediately behind the Right (North) Gatepost over the 배움터 지킴이실 booth and extends northward along the east walkway to the SE corner of the 4-story North Wing

structureAndColors.columns: Reddish-brown / terracotta-painted steel vertical support posts
structureAndColors.roofTrusses: Curved brown/grey steel arch ribs with circular web cutouts (원형 타공 철골 아치 프레임)
structureAndColors.roofCover: Translucent orange/amber-tinted polycarbonate barrel-vault canopy panels (주황/황토빛 반투명 아치형 지붕)

freestandingNoticeBoard.name: WaitingShelter / SchoolNoticeBoard
freestandingNoticeBoard.location: Immediately left (south) of the Left (South) Gatepost in front of the white picket perimeter fence (approx. offsetX: 103.5, offsetZ: 12.5)
freestandingNoticeBoard.appearance: 3-bay glass-encased outdoor bulletin board (3면 유리 게시판) with dark bronze/brown metal framing, a pitched dark-brown overhang roof with a circular school emblem in the center of the fascia, containing a '도로명주소 안내도' map and school posters

noticeBoardsAndSouthGateSide.perimeterFenceSouthOfGate: White vertical metal picket fence (~1.8m tall) behind the notice board

blueTrimmedAnnexShed.name: EastBlueRoofAnnex
blueTrimmedAnnexShed.location: Just south of the freestanding notice board (approx. offsetX: 102.8, offsetZ: 25.0)
blueTrimmedAnnexShed.appearance: 1-story light-grey horizontal corrugated-siding utility/storage shed with a bright blue roof fascia band and an open bay facing east/north

2_gangnamMaruGym_SouthAnnex.name: 강남마루 (SouthAnnex — 체육관·병설유치원·급식동)
2_gangnamMaruGym_SouthAnnex.visibilityInRoadview: Visible in the background left (looking due West -90 deg from DlPs12G8z5Yxtle6UuL7Ug) across the sandy playground, directly behind the Left (South) Gatepost solar trusses and south of the 4-story red-brick West Wing

facadeColors.roofCorniceBand: Dark charcoal / slate-grey horizontal roof fascia band with a slightly stepped-up central/southern parapet
facadeColors.upperFacadeWall: Light cool grey / off-white smooth cladding panel band across the upper half
facadeColors.middleLowerAccentFrame: Warm terracotta / burnt orange-brown (주황갈색) stepped geometric wall cladding framing the lower-middle window zone
facadeColors.windows: Horizontal ribbon of dark-tinted rectangular gym/clerestory windows with white/silver frames set into both the upper light-grey band and the terracotta-framed zone

signPositionAndStyle.position: Upper-right (northern) bay of the East facade (facing the playground and East Main Gate), mounted on the light-grey upper wall band just below the dark charcoal roof fascia and adjacent to the southern end of the red-brick West Wing
signPositionAndStyle.style: Horizontal individual dimensional channel letters ('강 남 마 루') in a warm yellow-gold / light tan tone

3_backgroundApartmentGableWalls.complexName: 석미한아름아파트 (Seokmi Hanareum Apartments, west of the school across SchoolWest road)
3_backgroundApartmentGableWalls.viewContext: When looking due West (-90 deg) from the East Main Gate (DlPs12G8z5Yxtle6UuL7Ug), three high-rise apartment towers (~15–20 stories) rise above the school skyline from left (south-west) to right (north-west), each featuring a pastel-colored east gable wall with '석미' box logo and two-line English branding text

towersLeftToRight.visualPosition: Far left of the main gate view (rising behind 강남마루 / SouthAnnex); also appears directly ahead at the west end of southern 강남1길 in page-2026-10-23T11-52-50-259Z.png

gableWallColors.primaryBand: Light sky blue / pastel ice blue (연청색 / 하늘색) wide vertical center-left band on the east gable wall
gableWallColors.trimAndEdges: White outer wall strips with a grey-blue peaked gable roof cap
gableWallColors.textColor: Medium grey / slate blue-grey ('Heritage' on line 1, 'Town' on line 2) in the upper third of the light-blue wall

towersLeftToRight.visualPosition: Center-left of the main gate view, rising in the gap between 강남마루 (SouthAnnex) and the 4-story red-brick main school building (with a distant red-and-white lattice telecom tower visible between Heritage Town and Beautiful People)

gableWallColors.primaryBand: Pastel pink / rose pink (연분홍색 / 핑크색) vertical band on the right/center of the east gable wall, paired with a very pale pink/off-white strip on the left side
gableWallColors.trimAndEdges: Dark grey/brown thin roof cap trim
gableWallColors.textColor: Dark charcoal grey ('Beautiful' on line 1, 'People' on line 2) in the upper third of the gable wall

towersLeftToRight.visualPosition: Center-right of the main gate view, rising above the central section of the 4-story red-brick North Wing

gableWallColors.primaryBand: Light mint green / pastel sage green (연녹색 / 민트그린) vertical band on the east gable wall
gableWallColors.secondaryAccent: Pastel pink/coral vertical strip along the right (northern) edge of the gable wall and small pink pediment accents along the apartment roofline
gableWallColors.textColor: Dark charcoal grey ('Wellbeing' on line 1, 'Life' on line 2) in the upper third of the light-green wall

additionalBackgroundTowers.direction: WSW / SW (far left in DinCYGB6-nThfrMXe6v1VQ and page-2026-10-23T12-00-04-602Z.png)
additionalBackgroundTowers.description: High-rise white/light-grey apartment towers with green stylized brand graphic on the upper side wall, plus a lower red/brown brick church building with a red cross spire in the SW foreground

additionalBackgroundTowers.direction: NNW (far right above the eastern end of NorthWing)
additionalBackgroundTowers.description: Upper floors and pink-pediment roofline of the northern apartment block (현진에버빌 / 석미한아름 북동측 동) peeking above the 4-story school roof

southGangnam1Gil_SchoolSouth.roadContext: East-west branch of 강남1길 running along the southern perimeter fence of the school (between the school south fence and the 88-* shophouse row)

facadeArchitecture.firstFloor: Dark brown horizontal wood-slat cladding (진갈색 목재 외벽), double glass entrance doors, raised timber deck with low wooden balustrade railing along the sidewalk, and small plastic children's chairs outside
facadeArchitecture.secondFloor: Blue-tinted reflective glass curtain wall (4 columns x 3 rows of panes) framed by medium-grey stone-tile piers and spandrel bands
facadeArchitecture.roof: Flat roof with dark grey metal coping and small solar/antenna frame at the NW corner

signsAndBanners.style: Large bold red Korean characters with white outlines and crackled brushstroke texture pasted across the window panes
Vertical white 3D channel letters arranged in two main columns with smaller vertical slogan text in the middle
Purple rectangular signboard with yellow slogan text and large white phone number

signsAndBanners.text: 은상 상금 1,000,000원 / 금상 상금 4,000,000원 / 어린이 보호차량 안내
signsAndBanners.style: Two white/red promotional posters to the left of the door and a yellow vertical banner on the wooden railing

adjacentWestShophouse_88_21.appearance: 1-story commercial building immediately west of 정상태권도, featuring a dark charcoal pitched roof overhang, dark-framed storefront windows, and a small white/red sign at the western corner

eastGangnam1Gil_SchoolEast.roadContext: Primary north-south 강남1길 road running directly in front of the East Main Gate

eastSideShophousePois_NorthToSouth.zone: Between 강남6길 and 강남7길 (directly opposite the East Main Gate)
pois: 강남1길 75 (다이클로 / 클레버 사이언스 과학 — orange/terracotta roof in satellite)
푸르넷공부방 (directly opposite the North Gatepost — reddish-brown roof in satellite)
강남1길 81 (멜로우블랙 카페 / 모모뷰티 — directly opposite the South Gatepost)
강남7길 1 / 5 (모니카 영어교습소 — at the north corner of 강남7길)

eastRoadInFrontOfMainGate.surface: Medium-dark grey asphalt roadway (~8.0–8.5m wide) merging smoothly into a wide paved gate apron on the west side
eastRoadInFrontOfMainGate.centerLine: Slightly faded double solid yellow center line (황색 복선 중앙선) running north-south along 강남1길
eastRoadInFrontOfMainGate.crosswalks: White zebra crosswalks located north of the main gate (near 다이클로/푸르넷공부방) and south of the gate (at the 강남7길 / SchoolSouth intersections)
eastRoadInFrontOfMainGate.overheadUtilities: Multiple black overhead power and telecom cables running parallel to 강남1길 across the upper sky

southRoadInFrontOfTaekwondo.surface: Two-lane grey asphalt street (~6.0m carriageway) sloping gently
southRoadInFrontOfTaekwondo.centerLine: Clear double solid yellow center line (황색 실선 중앙선 2줄)
southRoadInFrontOfTaekwondo.edgeLine: Solid white edge line (백색 길가장자리 구역선) along the southern curb in front of 정상태권도
southRoadInFrontOfTaekwondo.trafficCalmingAndSigns: Yellow-and-white chevron-striped speed bump / raised crosswalk ahead near the SW corner of the school, paired with a blue '어린이보호구역' (School Zone) post sign and overhead yellow flashing signal arm
southRoadInFrontOfTaekwondo.schoolSouthBoundary: Low stone/concrete retaining wall topped by a green metal mesh fence and a dense row of pine trees (소나무) along the north side of the road, with cars and a white box truck parked along the curb
